title: qslab: Quantum Spin Liquid Laboratory
description: A Python toolkit for simulating quantum spin liquids with complementary many-body methods: exact diagonalisation, the exact Majorana solution of the Kitaev model with projection onto physical states, stabilizer topological entanglement entropy, partons with Gutzwiller-projected variational Monte Carlo, DMRG and neural quantum states. It covers the Kitaev, J-K-Gamma-Gamma', toric-code, kagome, triangular and square J1-J2 models, includes executed tutorial notebooks and quizzes, and runs in parallel on one node, with optional MPI and GPU.
